name: Harshit Verma
summary: B.Arch. undergraduate at IIT Kharagpur (graduating 2028) with back-to-back internships in AI/ML engineering, applied ML, and AI agent operations. Builds end-to-end ML pipelines, LLM-based extraction/reranking systems, and automation tooling. Comfortable with Python/SQL, classical ML and deep learning, and RAG/LLM systems.

bullets: Engineered an automated Fireflies API pipeline to capture and process 250+ Google Meet transcripts for downstream task extraction across client workflows.
Captured 170 of 179 discussed tasks at 95% recall accuracy by architecting an LLM-based extraction pipeline converting transcripts into structured JSON.
Devised a fuzzy-matching pipeline with LLM reranking to reconcile extracted tasks against existing entries, eliminating duplicate task creation at scale.
Orchestrated a Telegram BotFather approval workflow enabling one-tap human validation before pushing confirmed tasks to Trello via API integrations.
Architected a scalable filter-then-rank pipeline using SQL filters, vector search, and skill-graph matching to surface top-50 candidates from 1M+ applicants.
Reduced average time-to-hire to 7 days via a production-ready filter-then-rank pipeline using SQL filters, cosine similarity, and skill-graph matching.
Engineered an LLM reranking layer that distilled 50 candidates into a curated shortlist of 10-15 through evidence-grounded relevance scoring.
Stored relational data and 1,536-dimensional embeddings in Supabase (pgvector), enabling efficient SQL + vector search across the full candidate pool.
Engineered an E2E ESG intelligence pipeline for a B2B Climate-Tech SaaS, extracting sustainability disclosures and predicting corporate carbon emissions.
Predicted emissions at log-R2 = 0.78 by stacking ensemble ML models atop a HistGradientBoosting baseline (log-R2 = 0.72) across 35+ engineered ESG predictors.
Structured 1800+ BRSR & ARs into a sector-wise ESG knowledge base via an end-to-end intelligence pipeline using Python, LLMs & schema-constrained JSON.
Delivered an enterprise emission prediction dashboard spanning 2000+ firms across 40+ sectors, enabling real-time ESG benchmarking across stakeholders.

positionsOfResponsibility.organization: Kshitij, IIT Kharagpur's Annual Techno-Management Festival
bullets: Led branding, creative design, and media operations for Kshitij, IIT Kharagpur's flagship techno-management festival.

competitions.title: First Runner-Up — CityScape: Lucknow Urban Mobility Case Competition
bullets: Secured 2nd place among 2,000+ participants by proposing an AI-driven multimodal urban mobility framework integrating EV infrastructure and reforms.
Engineered a YOLOv8-based traffic monitoring system with Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR) for real-time vehicle detection and violation tracking.
Designed a dynamic traffic signal optimization system adapting to real-time traffic density to improve intersection throughput across urban corridors.

projects.name: Swiggy Delivery-Time Prediction | End-to-End MLOps Pipeline
bullets: Achieved 3.13-min MAE and R2 of 0.83 using a stacked ensemble trained on 15+ engineered predictive delivery features from 45000+ Swiggy orders.
Architected a preprocessing workflow across 20+ raw features using sk-learn ColumnTransformer, PowerTransformer, encoding, and scaling for regression.
Productionized the pipeline with a 5-tool MLOps stack (FastAPI, Docker, DVC, MLflow, GitHub Actions), enabling end-to-end deployment and model versioning.

projects.name: Spotify Hybrid Music Recommendation Engine
bullets: Developed a hybrid ranking model blending content and collaborative similarity scores across 9K+ users and 30K songs, balancing relevance and diversity.
Engineered features using TF-IDF, one-hot encoding, frequency encoding, and feature scaling via sk-learn ColumnTransformer for content-based filtering.
Processed listening data using Dask and constructed a 30K x 962K sparse user-item matrix with SciPy CSR for efficient collaborative filtering at scale.

projects.name: RAG-Based YouTube Q&A System using LangChain & Gemini
bullets: Engineered a retrieval pipeline with Recursive Character Text Splitting and vector embeddings over 1,000+ transcript lines, enabling rapid semantic search.
Architected a RAG pipeline using LangChain, Gemini API, and ChromaDB with prompt templates and system prompts to improve overall answer relevance.
Integrated the pipeline into a Streamlit application enabling fully live interactive Q&A with sub-3s response latency across chunked YouTube transcripts.

entrepreneurial.organization: Quiet (privacy-first AI layer for lawyers and therapists)
bullets: Converted 3 early ICP-fit therapists into paid pilot users at $19/mo, conducting 40+ customer discovery interviews across 2 profession verticals (therapy & law).
Eliminated third-party breach risk for workflows by engineering a privacy-first AI note-taking tool using WhisperKit & Ollama for fully on-device transcription.
